commits_data.title: packet-aeron.c - Free key within aeron_frame_info_find()
commits_data.message:
packet-aeron.c - Free key within aeron_frame_info_find()

The fragmentation API doesn't allow for packet_info* to (easily) be passed in, so allocate the key used for lookup and then free it after the lookup is complete.  Removes the need for wmem_packet_scope()
